newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet steady at the lower levels, buyers relaxed.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet steady at the lower levels, buyers relaxed.

text.p: European Jet fuel premiums to gas oil futures were holding steady at the lower levels on Friday after a glut of prompt avails and slack buying interest saw them fall sharply this week, traders said.
The overhang of prompt avails and weakness of benchmark gas oil futures kept buyers relaxed and saw talk focusing on March gas oil futures related premiums.
Brokers said sellers were reluctant to offer cargoes into the void of buying interest but pegged notional levels for Feb deliveries around March IPE +$30 a tonne cif NWE.
FOB barge sellers were notionally around March IPE +$26-28
but here again buying interest was very thin.
Buying into Scandinavia was thought mostly covered and demand into the U.K. market was very thin as poor gas oil demand limited requirements.
Brokers said Mediterranean markets were looking very long and many sellers were eyeing arbitrage options.
Firm Far East markets were the main focus of this attention, but traders expected the demand be filled out of the Mideast Gulf as high freight costs remained restrictive.
They said Libyan barrels were asking around cif high evens to +$1 with European material asking a couple of dollars more.
